## Install

Download **`TeamsListener-Setup-<version>.exe`** below and run it. It installs for your user only (no admin rights).

> The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC".
> Click **More info → Run anyway**. You can check the download against `SHA256SUMS.txt`
> (`Get-FileHash .\TeamsListener-Setup-<version>.exe` in PowerShell).

The first transcription downloads the speech model once (`small.en`, about 480 MB).

See the [README](https://github.com/nithishtrystuffs/teams-listener#readme) for usage.
